analysis.primary_statistic: unweighted arithmetic mean of event endpoints
analysis.spearman_ties: average ranks followed by Pearson correlation of ranks

alphaearth.h3_reducer: unweighted mean of valid 10 m pixels
alphaearth.pre_year: ignition year minus 1, full calendar year
alphaearth.post_year: ignition year plus 1, full calendar year

h3_population.center_rule: H3 resolution 8 cell center is covered by the official MTBS boundary
h3_population.final_population: intersection of MTBS-reference-supported and Sentinel-2-supported cells, frozen before AlphaEarth pixel extraction

land_cover_audit.eligibility_effect: none; P06 mismatch is reported only
land_cover_audit.summary: area-weighted class fractions and dominant class

mtbs_reference.boundary_source: USFS EDW MTBS Burned Area Boundaries (All Years), ArcGIS layer 63
mtbs_reference.severity_source: USFS/GTAC/MTBS/annual_burn_severity_mosaics/v1 Severity, official annual mosaic clipped to official event boundary
mtbs_reference.spatial_reducer: 30 m raster pixel-center counts inside each H3 polygon

overlap_audit.failure_rule: unioned intersection with other MTBS boundaries ignited in Y-1 through Y+1 exceeds 5% of candidate boundary area
overlap_audit.source: USFS EDW MTBS Burned Area Boundaries (All Years), ArcGIS layer 63

p_gates.P01: official boundary, thematic raster, mask, and metadata exist and parse
p_gates.P02: exact temporal-window boundary overlap is at most 5% and event is isolable
p_gates.P03: final frozen common population has at least 200 H3-r8 cells
p_gates.P04: official FIRE_ID, dates, pre/post source IDs, map ID, CRS, and product metadata match the canonical freeze
p_gates.P05: reference and pre-AlphaEarth optical variables are finite and nonconstant on the frozen population
p_gates.P06: dominant land-cover audit, reported without eligibility effect

sealing.analysis_precondition: all ten final events have complete sealed feature files whose SHA-256 values match the sealed manifest
sealing.per_event_feature_files: written without correlation or endpoint fields

sentinel2.annual_composite: per-band median of all retained scenes
